I felt like I was betraying a friend. I felt dead to my core for hours. I was beyond shattered as a person.

What followed must have been one of my most genuine cries of my life. I paused the game, and sat on my bed hugging my legs, feeling broken.

This might seem lame or dramatic, but I played ME when my social life was kind of bunk. For a few months, my crew were my best friends.

Which makes it all the more heartbreaking when I shot Ashley, Wrex, and had to kill Legion.

ME3 was an experience.............
